unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded comment on issue #12 (re-sign-on-timeout double-settle): the nonce is buyer-chosen at sign time so payload dedup cannot catch a fresh nonce for the same logical charge. On Nano the settlement block IS the idempotency key - the buyer cannot re-sign a second authorization because the first send block already exists; the block hash is the dedup nonce and /settle reconciles against it. Offered to draft an additive nano:mainnet exact scheme leaving EVM paths untouched.
